verdicts.reason: A turns the headline into 'CONS TRUC TION' on one line with spaces, so the word reads as three broken fragments. Its elements are scattered to the corners with big dead areas in between, and the CTA sits between 'Buy 2 only for' and '$14.99', which splits the price message and breaks the reading order. B keeps the original's stacked headline, copy grouping and price-to-CTA flow. Its flaws: the brick and the blue X are cut off sharply in the middle of the canvas instead of at an edge, 'Sets for kids' sits jammed against the brick, and the whole layout clusters in the centre-left, leaving the right third empty.
